owner: harbor_master owns the clearance gate and its queue (Law 6). CC gates writes to this ticket.
intention: A clearance REQUEST and a clearance REFUSAL must each leave a trace owned by the gate's queue. Today the gate writes nothing until it GRANTS, so an attempt that was refused leaves no record that it happened.
why: voyage.py:70 already states it as an IOU: 'the clearance REQUEST must leave a trace owned by the gate's queue (clearance today writes nothing until it grants)'. It became load-bearing on 2026-07-26 when Akien settled how dependencies work: a node is either unverified at its gate or unpicked-up, and the ATTEMPT is the measurement. That model is cheaper and more honest than a stored guess about blocking — but only if a failed attempt is RECORDED. Otherwise the same wall gets walked into twice, which is Law 1's defect precisely: re-deriving a settled answer. Akien, shown this: 'Agree. needs a fix.'
traces_to: Law 1 — an attempt that leaves no trace guarantees the next mind repeats it.
Law 7 — errors are loud at diagnostic surfaces and permanent in records of truth. A refusal is an error-class outcome that is currently silent everywhere.
Law 6 — the queue is the gate's own; the trace belongs to harbor_master and is written through its door, not by callers.
Law 3 — a refusal is a MEASUREMENT of what the gate would not permit, and measurements are the thing this system keeps.

falsifier: A REFUSED clearance must leave a durable record carrying who asked, for what transition, when, and the refusal REASON — and that record must be readable afterwards. A grant must be distinguishable from a refusal in the record. A hollow build passes by logging only grants (the present behaviour) or by writing a refusal with no reason, which is loud without being useful.

distinctions_recorded: KIN TO stage-needs, NOT A CHILD OF IT. Both express one principle — the fact that we went and looked gets compiled in — but they sit on different surfaces with different owners. stage-needs records what a STAGE needs and what we measured about the world; this records what the GATE was asked and what it answered. Law 6 says harbor_master gates its own queue, so this is its own node.

THE WRITER GOES AT THE FRAME, NOT THE RAISE SITES — measured, not chosen. 14 refusal paths reach a caller of clear() and only 7 raise inside the decision function's own text; the other 7 are OwnerUnresolvable propagating out of boat_owner_of, a helper shared with readers that clear nothing. A per-raise-site build passes review and records half the surface. The cost of the frame is that clear() had to split into a public door around a private _decide(), and the first cut of that door took **kwargs and silently erased the keyword-only structure that makes proven_by unsmuggleable.

THE CONSUMER IS A LAW 7 DECISION, AND THE CODE ALREADY DECIDED IT. learning_block's write_trace reaps consumer='debug' records past DEBUG_TTL_DAYS=30 on every subsequent write. That structurally disqualifies 'debug' for a record of truth — the queue is 'training', and the tooth ages a store 400 days rather than citing the constant.

THE READ FACE BELONGS TO THE QUEUE'S OWNER, AND THE SECOND CONSUMER IS WHAT PROVES IT. The reader was written inside the probe and was correct there while the probe was alone. The moment voyage.py's [X] marker wanted the same fact, a copy would have meant two spellings of one block/event/consumer vocabulary — and a drifted copy does not fail loudly, it reports a confident zero. It lives at clearance.read_attempts() now (Law 6); the probe composes it and only counts.

A PRE-DECLARED MARKER CAN OUTLIVE ITS OWN REASON. [R] requested and [X] refused were both filed as waiting on 'the queue'. With the queue built, neither grafted, and they did not even want the same thing: [R] presumes a DWELL state a synchronous gate does not have (it waits on a design question, not on data), while [X] has its fact and lacks a 'still refused since the last journaled crossing' predicate — without which the flag pins on the first refusal and fires on normal motion. The blanket sentence that covered both is the defect: one phrase over a set that stops being uniform is how a filed absence outlives the voyage that filled it. It fired the acceptance instrument RED.

A PROOF THAT MANUFACTURES REFUSALS MUST NOT REACH THE COUNTED STORE. Both harbor_master proofs redirect CAIRN_LB_TRACE_ROOT at import and assert byte-identity on the live file at the end. This is what makes the refusal recorded during this voyage's own close genuine evidence rather than noise — nothing in the test tree can put a record there.
